CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_successful_payment(p_order_id uuid, p_stripe_payment_intent_id text, p_stripe_charge_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_order RECORD;
    v_seller_amount numeric;
BEGIN
    -- 1. Получаем данные заказа
    SELECT * INTO v_order FROM orders WHERE id = p_order_id;
    
    IF v_order IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Order not found');
    END IF;

    IF v_order.status = 'paid' THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'Order already paid');
    END IF;

    -- 2. Обновляем статус заказа
    -- ВАЖНО: У вас есть триггер 'trigger_order_status_change', 
    -- который сам обновит статистику продаж в user_profiles и пометит товар как 'sold'.
    UPDATE orders 
    SET 
        status = 'paid',
        payment_method_id = NULL, -- Или ID сохраненной карты, если есть
        stripe_payment_intent_id = p_stripe_payment_intent_id,
        paid_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = p_order_id;

    -- 3. Записываем транзакцию для ПОКУПАТЕЛЯ (Расход)
    INSERT INTO transactions (
        user_id, order_id, type, amount, description, stripe_charge_id
    ) VALUES (
        v_order.buyer_id, 
        v_order.id, 
        'purchase', 
        v_order.total_amount, -- Сколько покупатель заплатил всего
        'Order payment #' || v_order.order_number,
        p_stripe_charge_id
    );

    -- 4. Записываем транзакцию для ПРОДАВЦА (Доход)
    -- Обычно продавец видит "грязную" сумму продаж или чистую (за вычетом комиссии)
    -- В вашей схеме есть поле platform_fee в orders, используем его.
    INSERT INTO transactions (
        user_id, order_id, type, amount, description, stripe_charge_id
    ) VALUES (
        v_order.seller_id, 
        v_order.id, 
        'sale', 
        v_order.subtotal, -- Обычно продавцу идет подсумма товара (без налогов платформы, если они есть)
        'Sale earnings for order #' || v_order.order_number,
        p_stripe_charge_id
    );

    -- 5. Записываем комиссию платформы (Расход продавца или доход платформы)
    -- Обычно это вычитается из баланса продавца
    IF v_order.platform_fee > 0 THEN
        INSERT INTO transactions (
            user_id, order_id, type, amount, description, stripe_charge_id
        ) VALUES (
            v_order.seller_id, 
            v_order.id, 
            'platform_fee', 
            -v_order.platform_fee, -- Отрицательное значение, так как это вычет
            'Platform fee for order #' || v_order.order_number,
            p_stripe_charge_id
        );
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_reviews(p_user_id uuid, p_role text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(review_id uuid, rating integer, title character varying, content text, would_recommend boolean, created_at timestamp with time zone, reviewer_username character varying, reviewer_avatar_url text, product_id uuid, product_title character varying, product_price numeric, product_image text, images jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        r.id AS review_id,
        r.rating,
        r.title,
        r.content,
        r.would_recommend,
        r.created_at,
        rp.username AS reviewer_username,
        rp.avatar_url AS reviewer_avatar_url,
        r.product_id,
        p.title AS product_title,
        p.price AS product_price,
        (
            SELECT pi.image_url 
            FROM product_images pi 
            WHERE pi.product_id = p.id AND pi.is_main = true 
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS product_image,
        COALESCE(
            (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                'id', ri.id,
                'image_url', ri.image_url
            ) ORDER BY ri.sort_order)
            FROM review_images ri WHERE ri.review_id = r.id),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ) AS images
    FROM reviews r
    JOIN user_profiles rp ON rp.user_id = r.reviewer_id
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id
    WHERE r.reviewed_id = p_user_id
      AND r.role = p_role::review_role
      AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
    LIMIT p_limit
    OFFSET p_offset;
END;
$function$

AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
    v_has_pending_orders BOOLEAN;
    v_has_active_promotions BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
    -- Ensure user is authenticated
    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
            'success', false,
            'error', 'Not authenticated'
        );
    END IF;

    -- Check for pending orders (as seller)
    SELECT EXISTS(
        SELECT 1 FROM orders 
        WHERE seller_id = v_user_id 
        AND status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped')
    ) INTO v_has_pending_orders;
    
    IF v_has_pending_orders THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
            'success', false,
            'error', 'You have pending orders. Please complete or cancel them before deleting your account.',
            'action_required', 'complete_orders'
        );
    END IF;
    
    -- Check for active promotions
    SELECT EXISTS(
        SELECT 1 FROM promotions 
        WHERE seller_id = v_user_id 
        AND ends_at > NOW()
        AND deleted_at IS NULL
    ) INTO v_has_active_promotions;
    
    IF v_has_active_promotions THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
            'success', false,
            'error', 'You have active promotions. Please wait for them to end.',
            'action_required', 'wait_promotions'
        );
    END IF;
    
    -- ============================================
    -- BEGIN DELETION PROCESS
    -- ============================================
    
    -- Remove social connections
    DELETE FROM follows WHERE follower_id = v_user_id OR following_id = v_user_id;
    DELETE FROM blocked_users WHERE blocker_id = v_user_id OR blocked_id = v_user_id;
    
    -- Remove user preferences
    DELETE FROM wishlists WHERE user_id = v_user_id;
    DELETE FROM video_likes WHERE user_id = v_user_id;
    DELETE FROM notifications WHERE user_id = v_user_id;
    DELETE FROM user_settings WHERE user_id = v_user_id;
    
    -- Soft delete conversations (preserve for other party)
    UPDATE conversations
    SET deleted_at = NOW()
    WHERE buyer_id = v_user_id OR seller_id = v_user_id;
    
    -- Anonymize reviews (keep ratings for integrity, hide content)
    UPDATE reviews
    SET 
        content = '[Deleted User]',
        title = NULL,
        deleted_at = NOW()
    WHERE reviewer_id = v_user_id;
    
    -- Soft delete seller content
    UPDATE products
    SET 
        deleted_at = NOW(),
        status = 'archived'
    WHERE seller_id = v_user_id;
    
    UPDATE shortlists
    SET deleted_at = NOW()
    WHERE seller_id = v_user_id;
    
    UPDATE videos
    SET deleted_at = NOW()
    WHERE user_id = v_user_id;
    
    -- Deactivate integrations
    UPDATE shopify_integrations
    SET 
        deleted_at = NOW(),
        is_active = FALSE,
        access_token = 'DELETED',
        webhook_secret = NULL
    WHERE user_id = v_user_id;
    
    -- Soft delete payment & shipping info
    UPDATE payment_methods
    SET deleted_at = NOW()
    WHERE user_id = v_user_id;
    
    UPDATE shipping_addresses
    SET deleted_at = NOW()
    WHERE user_id = v_user_id;
    
    -- Anonymize user profile (keep record for order history integrity)
    UPDATE user_profiles
    SET 
        deleted_at = NOW(),
        username = 'deleted_' || substr(md5(random()::text), 1, 8),
        first_name = 'Deleted',
        last_name = 'User',
        email = 'deleted_' || v_user_id || '@deleted.local',
        phone = NULL,
        phone_verified = FALSE,
        avatar_url = NULL,
        bio = NULL,
        business_name = NULL,
        business_email = NULL,
        business_address = NULL,
        is_private = TRUE,
        is_seller = FALSE
    WHERE user_id = v_user_id;
    
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'message', 'Account permanently deleted',
        'auth_deletion_required', true
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_seller_stripe_earnings(p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_start_date timestamp with time zone DEFAULT (now() - '30 days'::interval), p_end_date timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS TABLE(total_earnings numeric, total_orders integer, pending_amount numeric, available_amount numeric, avg_order_value numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id UUID;
BEGIN
    v_user_id := COALESCE(p_user_id, auth.uid());
    
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(spi.seller_amount)::NUMERIC / 100, 0) AS total_earnings,
        COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS total_orders,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN spi.hold_until > NOW() AND spi.released_at IS NULL 
                     THEN spi.seller_amount ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC / 100, 0) AS pending_amount,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN spi.hold_until <= NOW() OR spi.released_at IS NOT NULL 
                     THEN spi.seller_amount ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC / 100, 0) AS available_amount,
        COALESCE(AVG(spi.seller_amount)::NUMERIC / 100, 0) AS avg_order_value
    FROM stripe_payment_intents spi
    WHERE spi.seller_id = v_user_id
    AND spi.status = 'succeeded'
    AND spi.created_at BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_conversations(p_filter text DEFAULT 'all'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, buyer_id uuid, seller_id uuid, product_id uuid, last_message_text text, last_message_at timestamp with time zone, buyer_unread_count integer, seller_unread_count integer, created_at timestamp with time zone, other_user_id uuid, other_user_username character varying, other_user_avatar text, other_user_last_active timestamp with time zone, product_title character varying, product_image text, product_price numeric, product_condition character varying, role text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
BEGIN
    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
    END IF;
    
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        c.id,
        c.buyer_id,
        c.seller_id,
        c.product_id,
        c.last_message_text,
        c.last_message_at,
        c.buyer_unread_count,
        c.seller_unread_count,
        c.created_at,
        CASE WHEN c.buyer_id = v_user_id THEN c.seller_id ELSE c.buyer_id END AS other_user_id,
        CASE WHEN c.buyer_id = v_user_id THEN seller_profile.username ELSE buyer_profile.username END AS other_user_username,
        CASE WHEN c.buyer_id = v_user_id THEN seller_profile.avatar_url ELSE buyer_profile.avatar_url END AS other_user_avatar,
        CASE WHEN c.buyer_id = v_user_id THEN seller_profile.last_active_at ELSE buyer_profile.last_active_at END AS other_user_last_active,
        p.title AS product_title,
        (
            SELECT pi.image_url 
            FROM product_images pi 
            WHERE pi.product_id = p.id AND pi.is_main = TRUE 
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS product_image,
        p.price AS product_price,
        cond.name AS product_condition,
        CASE
            WHEN c.buyer_id = v_user_id AND c.seller_id = v_user_id THEN 'both'
            WHEN c.buyer_id = v_user_id THEN 'buyer'
            ELSE 'seller'
        END AS role
    FROM conversations c
    LEFT JOIN user_profiles buyer_profile ON buyer_profile.user_id = c.buyer_id
    LEFT JOIN user_profiles seller_profile ON seller_profile.user_id = c.seller_id
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = c.product_id
    LEFT JOIN conditions cond ON cond.id = p.condition_id
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND (c.buyer_id = v_user_id OR c.seller_id = v_user_id)
    ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_seller_reviews(p_seller_id uuid, p_role text DEFAULT 'as_seller'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_reviews JSONB;
    v_total INTEGER;
    v_avg_rating NUMERIC(3,2);
BEGIN
    
    SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(AVG(r.rating), 0)
    INTO v_total, v_avg_rating
    FROM reviews r
    WHERE r.reviewed_id = p_seller_id
      AND r.role = p_role::review_role
      AND r.deleted_at IS NULL;
    
    
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
            'id', r.id,
            'rating', r.rating,
            'title', r.title,
            'content', r.content,
            'would_recommend', r.would_recommend,
            'created_at', r.created_at,
            
    
            'reviewer', jsonb_build_object(
                'id', up.user_id,
                'username', up.username,
                'avatar_url', up.avatar_url
            ),
            
    
            'product', CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
                'id', p.id,
                'title', p.title,
                'price', p.price,
                'main_image_url', (
                    SELECT pi.image_url FROM product_images pi 
                    WHERE pi.product_id = p.id AND pi.is_main = true 
                    LIMIT 1
                )
            ) ELSE NULL END,
            
    
            'images', (
                SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
                    jsonb_build_object(
                        'id', ri.id,
                        'image_url', ri.image_url
                    ) ORDER BY ri.sort_order
                ), '[]'::jsonb)
                FROM review_images ri
                WHERE ri.review_id = r.id
            )
        ) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
    ), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_reviews
    FROM reviews r
    LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = r.reviewer_id
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id
    WHERE r.reviewed_id = p_seller_id
      AND r.role = p_role::review_role
      AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
    LIMIT p_limit
    OFFSET p_offset;
    
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'reviews', v_reviews,
        'total', v_total,
        'avg_rating', v_avg_rating,
        'has_more', (p_offset + p_limit) < v_total
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_reviewable_orders(p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
BEGIN
    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        o.id AS order_id,
        o.order_number,
        o.delivered_at,
        o.seller_id,
        up.username AS seller_username,
        up.avatar_url AS seller_avatar,
        up.rating_as_seller AS seller_rating,
        up.total_reviews_as_seller AS seller_total_reviews,
        oi.product_id,
        oi.product_title::VARCHAR,
        oi.product_price AS product_price,
        (SELECT pi.image_url FROM product_images pi 
         WHERE pi.product_id = oi.product_id AND pi.is_main = TRUE LIMIT 1) AS product_image,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM reviews r 
            WHERE r.order_id = o.id 
              AND r.reviewer_id = v_user_id 
              AND r.role = 'as_seller'
              AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
        ) AS already_reviewed
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = o.seller_id
    WHERE o.buyer_id = v_user_id
      AND o.status = 'delivered'
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND up.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY o.delivered_at DESC
    LIMIT p_limit
    OFFSET p_offset;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_profile_with_reviews(p_user_id uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 10, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_as_seller JSONB;
    v_as_buyer JSONB;
    v_seller_stats JSONB;
    v_buyer_stats JSONB;
    v_overall_stats JSONB;
    v_seller_total INTEGER;
    v_buyer_total INTEGER;
    v_overall_total INTEGER;
    v_seller_avg FLOAT;
    v_buyer_avg FLOAT;
    v_overall_avg FLOAT;
    v_profile JSONB;
BEGIN
    -- Получаем данные профиля
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'id', up.id,
        'userId', up.user_id,
        'username', up.username,
        'avatarUrl', up.avatar_url,
        'bio', up.bio,
        'isSeller', up.is_seller,
        'sellerSince', up.seller_since,
        'followersCount', up.followers_count,
        'followingCount', up.following_count,
        'totalSales', up.total_sales,
        'ratingAsSeller', up.rating_as_seller::float,
        'totalReviewsAsSeller', up.total_reviews_as_seller,
        'ratingAsBuyer', up.rating_as_buyer::float,
        'totalReviewsAsBuyer', up.total_reviews_as_buyer,
        'itemsCount', (
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products 
            WHERE seller_id = p_user_id 
            AND status = 'active' 
            AND deleted_at IS NULL
        ),
        'soldCount', (
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products 
            WHERE seller_id = p_user_id 
            AND status = 'sold' 
            AND deleted_at IS NULL
        )
    )
    INTO v_profile
    FROM user_profiles up
    WHERE up.user_id = p_user_id AND up.deleted_at IS NULL;

    -- Получаем total и avg для seller
    SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(rating)::numeric, 1)::float, 0.0)
    INTO v_seller_total, v_seller_avg
    FROM reviews
    WHERE reviewed_id = p_user_id AND role = 'as_seller' AND deleted_at IS NULL;
    
    -- Получаем total и avg для buyer
    SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(rating)::numeric, 1)::float, 0.0)
    INTO v_buyer_total, v_buyer_avg
    FROM reviews
    WHERE reviewed_id = p_user_id AND role = 'as_buyer' AND deleted_at IS NULL;

    -- Получаем total и avg для overall (seller + buyer combined)
    SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(rating)::numeric, 1)::float, 0.0)
    INTO v_overall_total, v_overall_avg
    FROM reviews
    WHERE reviewed_id = p_user_id AND deleted_at IS NULL;

    -- Статистика as_seller с процентами
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'stars', jsonb_build_array(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'rating', 5,
                'count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 5),
                'percent', CASE WHEN v_seller_total > 0 
                    THEN ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 5))::numeric / v_seller_total, 2)::float
                    ELSE 0.0 END
            ),
            jsonb_build_object(
                'rating', 4,
                'count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 4),
                'percent', CASE WHEN v_seller_total > 0 
                    THEN ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 4))::numeric / v_seller_total, 2)::float
                    ELSE 0.0 END
            ),
            jsonb_build_object(
                'rating', 3,
                'count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 3),
                'percent', CASE WHEN v_seller_total > 0 
                    THEN ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 3))::numeric / v_seller_total, 2)::float
                    ELSE 0.0 END
            ),
            jsonb_build_object(
                'rating', 2,
                'count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 2),
                'percent', CASE WHEN v_seller_total > 0 
                    THEN ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 2))::numeric / v_seller_total, 2)::float
                    ELSE 0.0 END
            ),
            jsonb_build_object(
                'rating', 1,
                'count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 1),
                'percent', CASE WHEN v_seller_total > 0 
                    THEN ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 1))::numeric / v_seller_total, 2)::float
                    ELSE 0.0 END
            )
        )
    )
    INTO v_seller_stats
    FROM reviews
    WHERE reviewed_id = p_user_id AND role = 'as_seller' AND deleted_at IS NULL;
    
    -- Статистика as_buyer с процентами
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'stars', jsonb_build_array(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'rating', 5,
                'count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 5),
                'percent', CASE WHEN v_buyer_total > 0 
                    THEN ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 5))::numeric / v_buyer_total, 2)::float
                    ELSE 0.0 END
            ),
            jsonb_build_object(
                'rating', 4,
                'count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 4),
                'percent', CASE WHEN v_buyer_total > 0 
                    THEN ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 4))::numeric / v_buyer_total, 2)::float
                    ELSE 0.0 END
            ),
            jsonb_build_object(
                'rating', 3,
                'count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 3),
                'percent', CASE WHEN v_buyer_total > 0 
                    THEN ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 3))::numeric / v_buyer_total, 2)::float
                    ELSE 0.0 END
            ),
            jsonb_build_object(
                'rating', 2,
                'count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 2),
                'percent', CASE WHEN v_buyer_total > 0 
                    THEN ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 2))::numeric / v_buyer_total, 2)::float
                    ELSE 0.0 END
            ),
            jsonb_build_object(
                'rating', 1,
                'count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 1),
                'percent', CASE WHEN v_buyer_total > 0 
                    THEN ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 1))::numeric / v_buyer_total, 2)::float
                    ELSE 0.0 END
            )
        )
    )
    INTO v_buyer_stats
    FROM reviews
    WHERE reviewed_id = p_user_id AND role = 'as_buyer' AND deleted_at IS NULL;

    -- Статистика overall (все отзывы вместе)
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'stars', jsonb_build_array(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'rating', 5,
                'count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 5),
                'percent', CASE WHEN v_overall_total > 0 
                    THEN ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 5))::numeric / v_overall_total, 2)::float
                    ELSE 0.0 END
            ),
            jsonb_build_object(
                'rating', 4,
                'count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 4),
                'percent', CASE WHEN v_overall_total > 0 
                    THEN ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 4))::numeric / v_overall_total, 2)::float
                    ELSE 0.0 END
            ),
            jsonb_build_object(
                'rating', 3,
                'count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 3),
                'percent', CASE WHEN v_overall_total > 0 
                    THEN ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 3))::numeric / v_overall_total, 2)::float
                    ELSE 0.0 END
            ),
            jsonb_build_object(
                'rating', 2,
                'count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 2),
                'percent', CASE WHEN v_overall_total > 0 
                    THEN ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 2))::numeric / v_overall_total, 2)::float
                    ELSE 0.0 END
            ),
            jsonb_build_object(
                'rating', 1,
                'count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 1),
                'percent', CASE WHEN v_overall_total > 0 
                    THEN ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 1))::numeric / v_overall_total, 2)::float
                    ELSE 0.0 END
            )
        )
    )
    INTO v_overall_stats
    FROM reviews
    WHERE reviewed_id = p_user_id AND deleted_at IS NULL;
    
    -- Отзывы as_seller
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(review_data ORDER BY created_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_as_seller
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            r.created_at,
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', r.id,
                'rating', r.rating,
                'title', r.title,
                'content', r.content,
                'wouldRecommend', r.would_recommend,
                'createdAt', r.created_at,
                'reviewer', jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', up.user_id,
                    'username', up.username,
                    'avatarUrl', up.avatar_url
                ),
                'product', CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', p.id,
                    'title', p.title,
                    'price', p.price::float,
                    'mainImageUrl', (
                        SELECT pi.image_url FROM product_images pi 
                        WHERE pi.product_id = p.id AND pi.is_main = true 
                        LIMIT 1
                    )
                ) ELSE NULL END,
                'images', (
                    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
                        jsonb_build_object('id', ri.id, 'imageUrl', ri.image_url)
                        ORDER BY ri.sort_order
                    ), '[]'::jsonb)
                    FROM review_images ri WHERE ri.review_id = r.id
                )
            ) as review_data
        FROM reviews r
        LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = r.reviewer_id
        LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id
        WHERE r.reviewed_id = p_user_id AND r.role = 'as_seller' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
        LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset
    ) sub;
    
    -- Отзывы as_buyer
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(review_data ORDER BY created_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_as_buyer
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            r.created_at,
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', r.id,
                'rating', r.rating,
                'title', r.title,
                'content', r.content,
                'wouldRecommend', r.would_recommend,
                'createdAt', r.created_at,
                'reviewer', jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', up.user_id,
                    'username', up.username,
                    'avatarUrl', up.avatar_url
                ),
                'product', CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', p.id,
                    'title', p.title,
                    'price', p.price::float,
                    'mainImageUrl', (
                        SELECT pi.image_url FROM product_images pi 
                        WHERE pi.product_id = p.id AND pi.is_main = true 
                        LIMIT 1
                    )
                ) ELSE NULL END,
                'images', (
                    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
                        jsonb_build_object('id', ri.id, 'imageUrl', ri.image_url)
                        ORDER BY ri.sort_order
                    ), '[]'::jsonb)
                    FROM review_images ri WHERE ri.review_id = r.id
                )
            ) as review_data
        FROM reviews r
        LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = r.reviewer_id
        LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id
        WHERE r.reviewed_id = p_user_id AND r.role = 'as_buyer' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
        LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset
    ) sub;
    
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'profile', v_profile,
        'overall', jsonb_build_object(
            'total', v_overall_total,
            'avgRating', v_overall_avg,
            'stars', v_overall_stats->'stars'
        ),
        'asSeller', jsonb_build_object(
            'reviews', v_as_seller,
            'total', v_seller_total,
            'avgRating', v_seller_avg,
            'stars', v_seller_stats->'stars',
            'hasMore', (p_offset + p_limit) < v_seller_total
        ),
        'asBuyer', jsonb_build_object(
            'reviews', v_as_buyer,
            'total', v_buyer_total,
            'avgRating', v_buyer_avg,
            'stars', v_buyer_stats->'stars',
            'hasMore', (p_offset + p_limit) < v_buyer_total
        )
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_seller_dashboard()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id        UUID    := auth.uid();
    v_username       TEXT;
    v_avatar_url     TEXT;
    v_first_name     TEXT;
    v_revenue_cur    NUMERIC := 0;
    v_revenue_prev   NUMERIC := 0;
    v_active         BIGINT  := 0;
    v_views          BIGINT  := 0;
    v_sales          INTEGER := 0;
    v_pending_count  BIGINT  := 0;
    v_items_to_ship  JSONB;
    v_shortlist_count BIGINT := 0;
BEGIN
    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required';
    END IF;

    -- 1. Профиль продавца
    SELECT up.username, up.first_name, up.avatar_url
    INTO v_username, v_first_name, v_avatar_url
    FROM user_profiles up
    WHERE up.user_id = v_user_id AND up.deleted_at IS NULL;

    -- 2. Revenue текущего месяца
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)
    INTO v_revenue_cur
    FROM transactions
    WHERE user_id = v_user_id
      AND type = 'sale'
      AND created_at >= date_trunc('month', now());

    -- 3. Revenue прошлого месяца
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)
    INTO v_revenue_prev
    FROM transactions
    WHERE user_id = v_user_id
      AND type = 'sale'
      AND created_at >= date_trunc('month', now() - interval '1 month')
      AND created_at <  date_trunc('month', now());

    -- 4. Активные листинги
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_active
    FROM products
    WHERE seller_id = v_user_id
      AND status = 'active'
      AND deleted_at IS NULL;

    -- 5. Суммарные просмотры
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(views_count), 0)
    INTO v_views
    FROM products
    WHERE seller_id = v_user_id
      AND deleted_at IS NULL;

    -- 6. Всего продаж
    SELECT COALESCE(total_sales, 0)
    INTO v_sales
    FROM user_profiles
    WHERE user_id = v_user_id;

    -- 7. Кол-во заказов на отправку
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_pending_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE seller_id = v_user_id
      AND status = 'paid'
      AND deleted_at IS NULL;

    -- 8. Кол-во активных шортлистов
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_shortlist_count
    FROM shortlists
    WHERE seller_id = v_user_id
      AND status = 'active'
      AND deleted_at IS NULL;

    -- 9. Топ-3 заказа на отправку
    SELECT jsonb_agg(row_to_json(s))
    INTO v_items_to_ship
    FROM (
        SELECT
            o.id                AS order_id,
            o.order_number,
            o.total_amount,
            o.created_at        AS order_date,
            oi.product_id,
            oi.product_title,
            oi.product_price,
            oi.quantity,
            up_buyer.username   AS buyer_username,
            up_buyer.avatar_url AS buyer_avatar,
            (
                SELECT pi.image_url
                FROM product_images pi
                WHERE pi.product_id = oi.product_id
                  AND pi.is_main = TRUE
                LIMIT 1
            ) AS product_image
        FROM orders o
        JOIN order_items oi    ON oi.order_id = o.id
        JOIN user_profiles up_buyer ON up_buyer.user_id = o.buyer_id
        WHERE o.seller_id = v_user_id
          AND o.status = 'paid'
          AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY o.created_at ASC
        LIMIT 3
    ) s;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'username',           COALESCE(v_username, ''),
        'first_name',         COALESCE(v_first_name, ''),
        'avatar_url',         COALESCE(v_avatar_url, ''),
        'revenue',            v_revenue_cur,
        'revenue_prev_month', v_revenue_prev,
        'revenue_change_pct', CASE
                                WHEN v_revenue_prev = 0 THEN 0
                                ELSE ROUND(((v_revenue_cur - v_revenue_prev) / v_revenue_prev * 100)::numeric, 1)
                              END,
        'active_listings',    v_active,
        'total_views',        v_views,
        'total_sales',        v_sales,
        'pending_ship_count', v_pending_count,
        'shortlist_count',    v_shortlist_count,
        'items_to_ship',      COALESCE(v_items_to_ship, '[]'::jsonb)
    );
END;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_seller_info(p_seller_id uuid, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_result JSONB;
    v_reviews_as_seller JSONB;
    v_reviews_as_buyer JSONB;
    v_purchased_products JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_shortlists JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_is_following BOOLEAN := FALSE;
    v_is_blocked BOOLEAN := FALSE;
    v_is_own_profile BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
    IF p_user_id IS NOT NULL AND p_user_id = p_seller_id THEN
        v_is_own_profile := TRUE;
    END IF;

    IF p_user_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT v_is_own_profile THEN
        SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM follows
            WHERE follower_id = p_user_id AND following_id = p_seller_id
        ) INTO v_is_following;

        SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM blocked_users
            WHERE (blocker_id = p_user_id AND blocked_id = p_seller_id)
               OR (blocker_id = p_seller_id AND blocked_id = p_user_id)
        ) INTO v_is_blocked;
    END IF;

    -- Get recent reviews AS SELLER (limit 2)
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(rev_row ORDER BY rev_row->>'createdAt' DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_reviews_as_seller
    FROM (
        SELECT jsonb_build_object(
            'id', r.id,
            'rating', r.rating,
            'title', COALESCE(r.title, ''),
            'content', COALESCE(r.content, ''),
            'wouldRecommend', COALESCE(r.would_recommend, false),
            'createdAt', r.created_at,
            'reviewer', jsonb_build_object(
                'id', reviewer_up.user_id,
                'username', COALESCE(reviewer_up.username, ''),
                'avatarUrl', COALESCE(reviewer_up.avatar_url, '')
            ),
            'product', CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
                'id', p.id,
                'title', COALESCE(p.title, ''),
                'price', COALESCE(p.price, 0),
                'mainImageUrl', COALESCE(
                    (SELECT pi.image_url FROM product_images pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.id AND pi.is_main = TRUE LIMIT 1),
                    ''
                )
            ) ELSE NULL END,
            'images', COALESCE(
                (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', ri.id, 'imageUrl', ri.image_url) ORDER BY ri.sort_order)
                 FROM review_images ri WHERE ri.review_id = r.id),
                '[]'::jsonb
            )
        ) AS rev_row
        FROM reviews r
        JOIN user_profiles reviewer_up ON reviewer_up.user_id = r.reviewer_id
        LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id
        WHERE r.reviewed_id = p_seller_id
          AND r.role = 'as_seller'
          AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
        LIMIT 2
    ) sub;

    -- Get recent reviews AS BUYER (limit 2)
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(rev_row ORDER BY rev_row->>'createdAt' DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_reviews_as_buyer
    FROM (
        SELECT jsonb_build_object(
            'id', r.id,
            'rating', r.rating,
            'title', COALESCE(r.title, ''),
            'content', COALESCE(r.content, ''),
            'wouldRecommend', COALESCE(r.would_recommend, false),
            'createdAt', r.created_at,
            'reviewer', jsonb_build_object(
                'id', reviewer_up.user_id,
                'username', COALESCE(reviewer_up.username, ''),
                'avatarUrl', COALESCE(reviewer_up.avatar_url, '')
            ),
            'product', CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
                'id', p.id,
                'title', COALESCE(p.title, ''),
                'price', COALESCE(p.price, 0),
                'mainImageUrl', COALESCE(
                    (SELECT pi.image_url FROM product_images pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.id AND pi.is_main = TRUE LIMIT 1),
                    ''
                )
            ) ELSE NULL END,
            'images', COALESCE(
                (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', ri.id, 'imageUrl', ri.image_url) ORDER BY ri.sort_order)
                 FROM review_images ri WHERE ri.review_id = r.id),
                '[]'::jsonb
            )
        ) AS rev_row
        FROM reviews r
        JOIN user_profiles reviewer_up ON reviewer_up.user_id = r.reviewer_id
        LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id
        WHERE r.reviewed_id = p_seller_id
          AND r.role = 'as_buyer'
          AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
        LIMIT 2
    ) sub;

    -- Get purchased products
    IF p_user_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT v_is_own_profile THEN
        SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(prod_row ORDER BY prod_row->>'purchasedAt' DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
        INTO v_purchased_products
        FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT ON (oi.product_id) jsonb_build_object(
                'id', oi.product_id,
                'orderId', o.id,
                'title', oi.product_title,
                'price', oi.product_price,
                'originalPrice', oi.product_price,
                'status', COALESCE(pr.status::text, 'sold'),
                'viewsCount', 0,
                'conditionName', COALESCE(
                    (SELECT c.name FROM conditions c WHERE c.id = pr.condition_id),
                    ''
                ),
                'mainImageUrl', COALESCE(
                    (SELECT pi.image_url FROM product_images pi 
                     WHERE pi.product_id = oi.product_id AND pi.is_main = TRUE LIMIT 1),
                    ''
                ),
                'isInWishlist', false,
                'createdAt', pr.created_at,
                'purchasedAt', o.paid_at,
                'orderNumber', o.order_number
            ) AS prod_row
            FROM order_items oi
            JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
            LEFT JOIN products pr ON pr.id = oi.product_id
            WHERE o.buyer_id = p_user_id
              AND o.seller_id = p_seller_id
              AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered')
            ORDER BY oi.product_id, o.created_at DESC
        ) sub;
    END IF;

    -- Get seller shortlists
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(sl_row ORDER BY sl_row->>'createdAt' DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_shortlists
    FROM (
        SELECT jsonb_build_object(
            'id', sl.id,
            'name', sl.name,
            'description', COALESCE(sl.description, ''),
            'totalItems', COALESCE(sl.total_items, 0),
            'discountPercentage', COALESCE(sl.discount_percentage, 0),
            'eventName', COALESCE(sl.event_name, ''),
            'shareCode', COALESCE(sl.share_code, ''),
            'status', sl.status::text,
            'isPublic', COALESCE(sl.is_public, true),
            'startDate', sl.start_date,
            'endDate', sl.end_date,
            'createdAt', sl.created_at,
            'coverImages', COALESCE(
                (SELECT jsonb_agg(img_row ORDER BY img_row->>'sortOrder')
                 FROM (
                    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
                        'productId', si.product_id,
                        'imageUrl', COALESCE(
                            (SELECT pi.image_url FROM product_images pi 
                             WHERE pi.product_id = si.product_id AND pi.is_main = TRUE LIMIT 1),
                            ''
                        ),
                        'sortOrder', si.sort_order
                    ) AS img_row
                    FROM shortlist_items si
                    WHERE si.shortlist_id = sl.id
                    ORDER BY si.sort_order
                    LIMIT 4
                 ) img_sub
                ),
                '[]'::jsonb
            ),
            'tags', COALESCE(
                (SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT t.name)
                 FROM shortlist_items si2
                 JOIN products p2 ON p2.id = si2.product_id
                 JOIN product_tags pt ON pt.product_id = p2.id
                 JOIN tags t ON t.id = pt.tag_id
                 WHERE si2.shortlist_id = sl.id
                 LIMIT 5),
                '[]'::jsonb
            )
        ) AS sl_row
        FROM shortlists sl
        WHERE sl.seller_id = p_seller_id
          AND sl.status = 'active'
          AND sl.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND (sl.is_public = true OR (p_user_id IS NOT NULL AND p_user_id = p_seller_id))
        ORDER BY sl.created_at DESC
    ) sub;

    -- Build main result
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'id', up.user_id,
        'username', COALESCE(up.username, ''),
        'avatar_url', COALESCE(up.avatar_url, ''),
        'bio', COALESCE(up.bio, ''),
        -- Rating as seller
        'rating_as_seller', COALESCE(
            (SELECT AVG(r.rating)::numeric(3,2) FROM reviews r 
             WHERE r.reviewed_id = p_seller_id AND r.role = 'as_seller' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL),
            0
        ),
        'total_reviews_as_seller', (
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews r 
             WHERE r.reviewed_id = p_seller_id AND r.role = 'as_seller' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
        ),
        -- Rating as buyer
        'rating_as_buyer', COALESCE(
            (SELECT AVG(r.rating)::numeric(3,2) FROM reviews r 
             WHERE r.reviewed_id = p_seller_id AND r.role = 'as_buyer' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL),
            0
        ),
        'total_reviews_as_buyer', (
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews r 
             WHERE r.reviewed_id = p_seller_id AND r.role = 'as_buyer' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
        ),
        'total_sales', COALESCE(up.total_sales, 0),
        'followers_count', COALESCE(up.followers_count, 0),
        'following_count', COALESCE(up.following_count, 0),
        'seller_since', up.seller_since,
        'is_private', COALESCE(up.is_private, false),
        'total_products', (
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products pr
            WHERE pr.seller_id = p_seller_id AND pr.status = 'active' AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL
        ),
        'total_shortlists', (
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shortlists sl
            WHERE sl.seller_id = p_seller_id AND sl.status = 'active' AND sl.deleted_at IS NULL
        ),
        'is_following', v_is_following,
        'is_own_profile', v_is_own_profile,
        'is_blocked', v_is_blocked,
        'reviews_as_seller', v_reviews_as_seller,
        'reviews_as_buyer', v_reviews_as_buyer,
        'purchased_products', v_purchased_products,
        'shortlists', v_shortlists
    )
    INTO v_result
    FROM user_profiles up
    WHERE up.user_id = p_seller_id
      AND up.deleted_at IS NULL;

    RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_order_review_data(p_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
    v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required';
    END IF;

    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'order_id', o.id,
        'order_number', o.order_number,
        'delivered_at', o.delivered_at,
        'purchased_at', o.paid_at,
        'seller_id', o.seller_id,
        'seller_username', up.username,
        'seller_avatar', up.avatar_url,
        'seller_rating', up.rating_as_seller,
        'seller_total_reviews', up.total_reviews_as_seller,
        'product_id', oi.product_id,
        'product_title', oi.product_title,
        'product_price', oi.product_price,
        'product_image', (
            SELECT pi.image_url FROM product_images pi 
            WHERE pi.product_id = oi.product_id AND pi.is_main = TRUE LIMIT 1
        ),
        'product_condition', cond.name,
        'can_review', NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM reviews r 
            WHERE r.order_id = o.id 
              AND r.reviewer_id = v_user_id 
              AND r.role = 'as_seller'
              AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
        )
    )
    INTO v_result
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = o.seller_id
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    LEFT JOIN conditions cond ON cond.id = p.condition_id
    WHERE o.id = p_order_id
      AND o.buyer_id = v_user_id
      AND o.status = 'delivered'
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
    LIMIT 1;

    IF v_result IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
            'success', false,
            'error', 'Order not found or not eligible for review'
        );
    END IF;

    RETURN v_result || jsonb_build_object('success', true);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_or_create_conversation(p_seller_id uuid, p_product_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, buyer_id uuid, seller_id uuid, product_id uuid, last_message_text text, last_message_at timestamp with time zone, buyer_unread_count integer, seller_unread_count integer, created_at timestamp with time zone, other_user_id uuid, other_user_username character varying, other_user_avatar text, product_title character varying, product_image text, product_price numeric, is_new boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$DECLARE
  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
  v_conversation_id UUID;
  v_is_new BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_other_user_id UUID;
BEGIN
  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
  END IF;

  IF v_user_id = p_seller_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot create conversation with yourself';
  END IF;

  -- Look for existing ACTIVE conversation in both directions
  SELECT c.id INTO v_conversation_id
  FROM conversations c
  WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND (
      (c.buyer_id = v_user_id AND c.seller_id = p_seller_id)
      OR
      (c.buyer_id = p_seller_id AND c.seller_id = v_user_id)
    )
    AND (
      p_product_id IS NULL
      OR
      c.product_id = p_product_id
    )
  ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1;

  -- If not found, hard-delete any soft-deleted one and create fresh
  IF v_conversation_id IS NULL THEN
    DELETE FROM conversations AS old_conv
    WHERE old_conv.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
      AND old_conv.buyer_id = v_user_id
      AND old_conv.seller_id = p_seller_id
      AND (
        (p_product_id IS NULL AND old_conv.product_id IS NULL)
        OR old_conv.product_id = p_product_id
      );

    INSERT INTO conversations AS conv (buyer_id, seller_id, product_id)
    VALUES (v_user_id, p_seller_id, p_product_id)
    ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT conversations_buyer_id_seller_id_product_id_key
    DO UPDATE SET
      deleted_at = NULL,
      updated_at = now()
    RETURNING conv.id INTO v_conversation_id;

    v_is_new := TRUE;
  END IF;

  -- Determine the "other user" relative to current user
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN c.buyer_id = v_user_id THEN c.seller_id
      ELSE c.buyer_id
    END INTO v_other_user_id
  FROM conversations c
  WHERE c.id = v_conversation_id;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    c.id,
    c.buyer_id,
    c.seller_id,
    c.product_id,
    c.last_message_text,
    c.last_message_at,
    c.buyer_unread_count,
    c.seller_unread_count,
    c.created_at,
    v_other_user_id,
    up.username,
    up.avatar_url,
    p.title,
    (
      SELECT pi.image_url
      FROM product_images pi
      WHERE pi.product_id = c.product_id
        AND pi.is_main = TRUE
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    p.price,
    v_is_new
  FROM conversations c
  LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = v_other_user_id AND up.deleted_at IS NULL
  LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = c.product_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
  WHERE c.id = v_conversation_id;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_wishlist_products(p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, title text, description text, price double precision, original_price double precision, flash_sale_enabled boolean, flash_sale_price double precision, flash_sale_ends_at timestamp with time zone, discount_type text, discount_amount double precision, quantity integer, year integer, issue_number integer, sku text, shipping_info text, shipping_price double precision, free_shipping boolean, use_seller_shipping boolean, custom_flat_rate double precision, custom_additional_item_fee double precision, shortlist_id uuid, views_count integer, status text, created_at timestamp with time zone, conditions jsonb, category jsonb, subcategory jsonb, seller jsonb, images jsonb, tags jsonb, is_in_wishlist boolean, is_own_product boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id UUID;
BEGIN
    v_user_id := COALESCE(p_user_id, auth.uid());

    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.title::TEXT,
        p.description::TEXT,
        p.price::DOUBLE PRECISION,
        p.original_price::DOUBLE PRECISION,
        COALESCE(p.flash_sale_enabled, FALSE),
        p.flash_sale_price::DOUBLE PRECISION,
        p.flash_sale_ends_at,
        p.discount_type::TEXT,
        p.discount_amount::DOUBLE PRECISION,
        COALESCE(p.quantity, 0),
        p.year,
        p.issue_number,
        p.sku::TEXT,
        p.shipping_info::TEXT,
        p.shipping_price::DOUBLE PRECISION,
        COALESCE(p.free_shipping, FALSE),
        COALESCE(p.use_seller_shipping, TRUE),
        p.custom_flat_rate::DOUBLE PRECISION,
        p.custom_additional_item_fee::DOUBLE PRECISION,
        p.shortlist_id,
        COALESCE(p.views_count, 0),
        p.status::TEXT,
        p.created_at,

        -- Conditions (array via product_conditions)
        (
            SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', c.id,
                    'name', c.name,
                    'code', c.code,
                    'description', c.description
                ) ORDER BY c.name
            ), '[]'::jsonb)
            FROM product_conditions pc
            JOIN conditions c ON c.id = pc.condition_id
            WHERE pc.product_id = p.id
        ) AS conditions,

        -- Category
        CASE WHEN cat.id IS NOT NULL THEN
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', cat.id,
                'name', cat.name,
                'slug', cat.slug
            )
        ELSE NULL END AS category,

        -- Subcategory
        CASE WHEN sub.id IS NOT NULL THEN
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', sub.id,
                'name', sub.name,
                'slug', sub.slug
            )
        ELSE NULL END AS subcategory,

        -- Seller
        CASE WHEN up.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', up.user_id,
                'username', up.username,
                'avatar_url', up.avatar_url,
                'rating', up.rating_as_seller,
                'total_reviews', up.total_reviews_as_seller,
                'total_sales', up.total_sales,
                'seller_since', up.seller_since
            )
        ELSE NULL END AS seller,

        -- Images
        (
            SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', pi.id,
                    'image_url', pi.image_url,
                    'is_main', pi.is_main,
                    'sort_order', pi.sort_order
                ) ORDER BY pi.is_main DESC, pi.sort_order ASC
            ), '[]'::jsonb)
            FROM product_images pi
            WHERE pi.product_id = p.id
        ) AS images,

        -- Tags
        (
            SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', t.id,
                    'name', t.name,
                    'slug', t.slug
                )
            ), '[]'::jsonb)
            FROM product_tags pt
            JOIN tags t ON t.id = pt.tag_id
            WHERE pt.product_id = p.id
        ) AS tags,

        TRUE AS is_in_wishlist,
        (p.seller_id = v_user_id) AS is_own_product

    FROM wishlists w
    INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = w.product_id
    LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = p.seller_id
    LEFT JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id
    LEFT JOIN subcategories sub ON sub.id = p.subcategory_id
    WHERE w.user_id = v_user_id
      AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY w.created_at DESC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_products_to_review(p_reviewed_user_id uuid, p_review_role text)

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
BEGIN
    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        oi.product_id,
        oi.product_title::VARCHAR,
        oi.product_price,
        (SELECT pi.image_url FROM product_images pi 
         WHERE pi.product_id = oi.product_id AND pi.is_main = TRUE LIMIT 1) AS product_image,
        cond.name AS product_condition,
        o.id AS order_id,
        o.order_number,
        o.paid_at AS order_paid_at,
        o.delivered_at AS order_delivered_at,
        o.refunded_at AS order_refunded_at,
        o.status AS order_status,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM reviews r 
            WHERE r.order_id = o.id 
              AND r.product_id = oi.product_id
              AND r.reviewer_id = v_user_id 
              AND r.role = p_review_role::review_role
              AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
        ) AS already_reviewed
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    LEFT JOIN conditions cond ON cond.id = p.condition_id
    WHERE 
        o.status IN ('delivered', 'refunded')
        AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND (
            -- "As Seller" tab: I'm the buyer, reviewing the seller
            -- Show products I bought from this seller
            (p_review_role = 'as_seller' AND o.buyer_id = v_user_id AND o.seller_id = p_reviewed_user_id)
            OR
            -- "As Buyer" tab: I'm the seller, reviewing the buyer
            -- Show products I sold to this buyer
            (p_review_role = 'as_buyer' AND o.seller_id = v_user_id AND o.buyer_id = p_reviewed_user_id)
        )
    ORDER BY o.delivered_at DESC NULLS LAST, o.paid_at DESC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_write_review_data(p_order_id uuid, p_product_id uuid, p_review_role text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
    v_reviewed_user_id UUID;
    v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required';
    END IF;

    -- Determine who is being reviewed
    IF p_review_role = 'as_seller' THEN
        -- Reviewing the seller → reviewed_user = seller_id
        SELECT o.seller_id INTO v_reviewed_user_id
        FROM orders o WHERE o.id = p_order_id AND o.buyer_id = v_user_id;
    ELSE
        -- Reviewing the buyer → reviewed_user = buyer_id
        SELECT o.buyer_id INTO v_reviewed_user_id
        FROM orders o WHERE o.id = p_order_id AND o.seller_id = v_user_id;
    END IF;

    IF v_reviewed_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Order not found or access denied');
    END IF;

    -- Check if already reviewed
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM reviews r
        WHERE r.order_id = p_order_id
          AND r.product_id = p_product_id
          AND r.reviewer_id = v_user_id
          AND r.role = p_review_role::review_role
          AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
    ) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Already reviewed this product for this order');
    END IF;

    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'order_id', o.id,
        'order_number', o.order_number,
        'order_status', o.status,
        'purchased_at', o.paid_at,
        'delivered_at', o.delivered_at,
        'refunded_at', o.refunded_at,
        -- Reviewed user info
        'reviewed_user_id', v_reviewed_user_id,
        'reviewed_username', up.username,
        'reviewed_avatar', up.avatar_url,
        'reviewed_rating_as_seller', up.rating_as_seller,
        'reviewed_rating_as_buyer', up.rating_as_buyer,
        'reviewed_total_reviews_as_seller', up.total_reviews_as_seller,
        'reviewed_total_reviews_as_buyer', up.total_reviews_as_buyer,
        -- Product info
        'product_id', oi.product_id,
        'product_title', oi.product_title,
        'product_price', oi.product_price,
        'product_image', (
            SELECT pi.image_url FROM product_images pi 
            WHERE pi.product_id = oi.product_id AND pi.is_main = TRUE LIMIT 1
        ),
        'product_condition', cond.name,
        -- Review context
        'review_role', p_review_role
    )
    INTO v_result
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id AND oi.product_id = p_product_id
    JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = v_reviewed_user_id
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    LEFT JOIN conditions cond ON cond.id = p.condition_id
    WHERE o.id = p_order_id
      AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'refunded')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND up.deleted_at IS NULL
    LIMIT 1;

    IF v_result IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Order/product not found or not eligible');
    END IF;

    RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_complete_schema()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    result jsonb;
BEGIN
    -- Get all enums
    WITH enum_types AS (
        SELECT 
            t.typname as enum_name,
            array_agg(e.enumlabel ORDER BY e.enumsortorder) as enum_values
        FROM pg_type t
        JOIN pg_enum e ON t.oid = e.enumtypid
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace
        WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
        GROUP BY t.typname
    )
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'enums',
        COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'name', enum_name,
                    'values', to_jsonb(enum_values)
                )
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        )
    )
    FROM enum_types
    INTO result;

    -- Get all tables with their details
    WITH RECURSIVE 
    columns_info AS (
        SELECT 
            c.oid as table_oid,
            c.relname as table_name,
            a.attname as column_name,
            format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) as column_type,
            a.attnotnull as notnull,
            pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid) as column_default,
            CASE 
                WHEN a.attidentity != '' THEN true
                WHEN pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid) LIKE 'nextval%' THEN true
                ELSE false
            END as is_identity,
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint con 
                WHERE con.conrelid = c.oid 
                AND con.contype = 'p' 
                AND a.attnum = ANY(con.conkey)
            ) as is_pk
        FROM pg_class c
        JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
        LEFT JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid
        LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid = c.oid AND d.adnum = a.attnum
        WHERE n.nspname = 'public' 
        AND c.relkind = 'r'
        AND a.attnum > 0 
        AND NOT a.attisdropped
    ),
    fk_info AS (
        SELECT 
            c.oid as table_oid,
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'name', con.conname,
                    'column', col.attname,
                    'foreign_schema', fs.nspname,
                    'foreign_table', ft.relname,
                    'foreign_column', fcol.attname,
                    'on_delete', CASE con.confdeltype
                        WHEN 'a' THEN 'NO ACTION'
                        WHEN 'c' THEN 'CASCADE'
                        WHEN 'r' THEN 'RESTRICT'
                        WHEN 'n' THEN 'SET NULL'
                        WHEN 'd' THEN 'SET DEFAULT'
                        ELSE NULL
                    END
                )
            ) as foreign_keys
        FROM pg_class c
        JOIN pg_constraint con ON con.conrelid = c.oid
        JOIN pg_attribute col ON col.attrelid = con.conrelid AND col.attnum = ANY(con.conkey)
        JOIN pg_class ft ON ft.oid = con.confrelid
        JOIN pg_namespace fs ON fs.oid = ft.relnamespace
        JOIN pg_attribute fcol ON fcol.attrelid = con.confrelid AND fcol.attnum = ANY(con.confkey)
        WHERE con.contype = 'f'
        GROUP BY c.oid
    ),
    index_info AS (
        SELECT 
            c.oid as table_oid,
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'name', i.relname,
                    'using', am.amname,
                    'columns', (
                        SELECT jsonb_agg(a.attname ORDER BY array_position(ix.indkey, a.attnum))
                        FROM unnest(ix.indkey) WITH ORDINALITY as u(attnum, ord)
                        JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum = u.attnum
                    )
                )
            ) as indexes
        FROM pg_class c
        JOIN pg_index ix ON ix.indrelid = c.oid
        JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = ix.indexrelid
        JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = i.relam
        WHERE NOT ix.indisprimary
        GROUP BY c.oid
    ),
    policy_info AS (
        SELECT 
            c.oid as table_oid,
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'name', pol.polname,
                    'command', CASE pol.polcmd
                        WHEN 'r' THEN 'SELECT'
                        WHEN 'a' THEN 'INSERT'
                        WHEN 'w' THEN 'UPDATE'
                        WHEN 'd' THEN 'DELETE'
                        WHEN '*' THEN 'ALL'
                    END,
                    'roles', (
                        SELECT string_agg(quote_ident(r.rolname), ', ')
                        FROM pg_roles r
                        WHERE r.oid = ANY(pol.polroles)
                    ),
                    'using', pg_get_expr(pol.polqual, pol.polrelid),
                    'check', pg_get_expr(pol.polwithcheck, pol.polrelid)
                )
            ) as policies
        FROM pg_class c
        JOIN pg_policy pol ON pol.polrelid = c.oid
        GROUP BY c.oid
    ),
    trigger_info AS (
        SELECT 
            c.oid as table_oid,
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'name', t.tgname,
                    'timing', CASE 
                        WHEN t.tgtype & 2 = 2 THEN 'BEFORE'
                        WHEN t.tgtype & 4 = 4 THEN 'AFTER'
                        WHEN t.tgtype & 64 = 64 THEN 'INSTEAD OF'
                    END,
                    'events', (
                        CASE WHEN t.tgtype & 1 = 1 THEN 'INSERT'
                             WHEN t.tgtype & 8 = 8 THEN 'DELETE'
                             WHEN t.tgtype & 16 = 16 THEN 'UPDATE'
                             WHEN t.tgtype & 32 = 32 THEN 'TRUNCATE'
                        END
                    ),
                    'statement', pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid)
                )
            ) as triggers
        FROM pg_class c
        JOIN pg_trigger t ON t.tgrelid = c.oid
        WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal
        GROUP BY c.oid
    ),
    table_info AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            c.table_oid,
            c.table_name,
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'name', c.column_name,
                    'type', c.column_type,
                    'notnull', c.notnull,
                    'default', c.column_default,
                    'identity', c.is_identity,
                    'is_pk', c.is_pk
                ) ORDER BY c.column_name
            ) as columns,
            COALESCE(fk.foreign_keys, '[]'::jsonb) as foreign_keys,
            COALESCE(i.indexes, '[]'::jsonb) as indexes,
            COALESCE(p.policies, '[]'::jsonb) as policies,
            COALESCE(t.triggers, '[]'::jsonb) as triggers
        FROM columns_info c
        LEFT JOIN fk_info fk ON fk.table_oid = c.table_oid
        LEFT JOIN index_info i ON i.table_oid = c.table_oid
        LEFT JOIN policy_info p ON p.table_oid = c.table_oid
        LEFT JOIN trigger_info t ON t.table_oid = c.table_oid
        GROUP BY c.table_oid, c.table_name, fk.foreign_keys, i.indexes, p.policies, t.triggers
    )
    SELECT result || jsonb_build_object(
        'tables',
        COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'name', table_name,
                    'columns', columns,
                    'foreign_keys', foreign_keys,
                    'indexes', indexes,
                    'policies', policies,
                    'triggers', triggers
                )
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        )
    )
    FROM table_info
    INTO result;

    -- Get all functions
    WITH function_info AS (
        SELECT 
            p.proname AS name,
            pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) AS definition
        FROM pg_proc p
        JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
        WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
        AND p.prokind = 'f'
    )
    SELECT result || jsonb_build_object(
        'functions',
        COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'name', name,
                    'definition', definition
                )
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        )
    )
    FROM function_info
    INTO result;

    RETURN result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_product_details(p_product_id uuid, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$DECLARE
    v_result JSONB;
BEGIN
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'id', p.id,
        'title', p.title,
        'description', p.description,
        'price', p.price,
        'original_price', p.original_price,
        'flash_sale_enabled', p.flash_sale_enabled,
        'flash_sale_price', p.flash_sale_price,
        'flash_sale_ends_at', p.flash_sale_ends_at,
        'discount_type', p.discount_type,
        'discount_amount', p.discount_amount,
        'quantity', p.quantity,
        'year', p.year,
        'issue_number', p.issue_number,
        'sku', p.sku,
'sku_number', p.sku_number,

        'shipping_info', p.shipping_info,
        'shipping_price', p.shipping_price,
        'free_shipping', p.free_shipping,
        'use_seller_shipping', p.use_seller_shipping,
        'custom_flat_rate', p.custom_flat_rate,
        'custom_additional_item_fee', p.custom_additional_item_fee,
        'shortlist_id', p.shortlist_id,
        'views_count', p.views_count,
        'status', p.status,
        'created_at', p.created_at,

        -- Conditions (array via product_conditions)
        'conditions', (
            SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', c.id,
                    'name', c.name,
                    'code', c.code,
                    'description', c.description
                ) ORDER BY c.name
            ), '[]'::jsonb)
            FROM product_conditions pc
            JOIN conditions c ON c.id = pc.condition_id
            WHERE pc.product_id = p.id
        ),

        -- Category
        'category', jsonb_build_object(
            'id', cat.id,
            'name', cat.name,
            'slug', cat.slug
        ),

        -- Subcategory
        'subcategory', CASE WHEN sub.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
            'id', sub.id,
            'name', sub.name,
            'slug', sub.slug
        ) ELSE NULL END,

        -- Seller
        'seller', jsonb_build_object(
            'id', up.user_id,
            'username', up.username,
            'avatar_url', up.avatar_url,
            'rating', up.rating_as_seller,
            'total_reviews', up.total_reviews_as_seller,
            'total_sales', up.total_sales,
            'seller_since', up.seller_since
        ),

        -- Images
        'images', (
            SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', pi.id,
                    'image_url', pi.image_url,
                    'is_main', pi.is_main,
                    'sort_order', pi.sort_order
                ) ORDER BY pi.is_main DESC, pi.sort_order ASC
            ), '[]'::jsonb)
            FROM product_images pi
            WHERE pi.product_id = p.id
        ),

        -- Tags
        'tags', (
            SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', t.id,
                    'name', t.name,
                    'slug', t.slug
                )
            ), '[]'::jsonb)
            FROM product_tags pt
            JOIN tags t ON t.id = pt.tag_id
            WHERE pt.product_id = p.id
        ),

        -- User-specific
        'is_in_wishlist', CASE
            WHEN p_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN EXISTS(
                SELECT 1 FROM wishlists w
                WHERE w.user_id = p_user_id AND w.product_id = p.id
            )
            ELSE false
        END,

        'is_own_product', CASE
            WHEN p_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.seller_id = p_user_id
            ELSE false
        END
    ) INTO v_result
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id
    LEFT JOIN subcategories sub ON sub.id = p.subcategory_id
    LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = p.seller_id
    WHERE p.id = p_product_id
      AND p.deleted_at IS NULL;

    IF v_result IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
            'success', false,
            'error', 'Product not found'
        );
    END IF;

    RETURN v_result;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_messages(p_conversation_id uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_before_date timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, conversation_id uuid, sender_id uuid, content text, message_type message_type, is_read boolean, created_at timestamp with time zone, sender_username character varying, sender_avatar text, images jsonb, counter_offer jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
BEGIN
    -- Проверка авторизации
    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
    END IF;
    
    -- Проверка доступа к чату
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM conversations c
        WHERE c.id = p_conversation_id
        AND (c.buyer_id = v_user_id OR c.seller_id = v_user_id)
        AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied';
    END IF;
    
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        m.id,
        m.conversation_id,
        m.sender_id,
        m.content,
        COALESCE(m.message_type, 'text'::message_type) AS message_type,
        m.is_read,
        m.created_at,
        -- Sender info
        up.username AS sender_username,
        up.avatar_url AS sender_avatar,
        -- Images as JSON array
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT jsonb_agg(
                    jsonb_build_object(
                        'id', mi.id,
                        'image_url', mi.image_url,
                        'thumbnail_url', mi.thumbnail_url,
                        'width', mi.width,
                        'height', mi.height
                    ) ORDER BY mi.sort_order
                )
                FROM message_images mi
                WHERE mi.message_id = m.id
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ) AS images,
        -- Counter offer as JSON (if exists)
        CASE 
            WHEN m.counter_offer_id IS NOT NULL THEN
                (
                    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
                        'id', co.id,
                        'original_price', co.original_price,
                        'offered_price', co.offered_price,
                        'status', co.status,
                        'from_user_id', co.from_user_id,
                        'to_user_id', co.to_user_id,
                        'expires_at', co.expires_at
                    )
                    FROM counter_offers co
                    WHERE co.id = m.counter_offer_id
                )
            ELSE NULL
        END AS counter_offer
    FROM messages m
    JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = m.sender_id
    WHERE m.conversation_id = p_conversation_id
    AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND (p_before_date IS NULL OR m.created_at < p_before_date)
    ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
    LIMIT p_limit;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_seller_shipping_to_products()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF (NEW.default_flat_shipping_rate IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.default_flat_shipping_rate) OR
     (NEW.default_additional_item_fee IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.default_additional_item_fee) THEN

    UPDATE products
    SET
      shipping_price = COALESCE(NEW.default_flat_shipping_rate, 0),
      custom_flat_rate = COALESCE(NEW.default_flat_shipping_rate, 0),
      custom_additional_item_fee = COALESCE(NEW.default_additional_item_fee, 0),
      updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE
      seller_id = NEW.user_id
      AND use_seller_shipping = TRUE
      AND deleted_at IS NULL;

  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_conversation_by_id(p_conversation_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, buyer_id uuid, seller_id uuid, product_id uuid, last_message_text text, last_message_at timestamp with time zone, buyer_unread_count integer, seller_unread_count integer, created_at timestamp with time zone, other_user_id uuid, other_user_username character varying, other_user_avatar text, other_user_last_active timestamp with time zone, product_title character varying, product_image text, product_price numeric, product_condition character varying)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
BEGIN
    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
    END IF;
    
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        c.id,
        c.buyer_id,
        c.seller_id,
        c.product_id,
        c.last_message_text,
        c.last_message_at,
        c.buyer_unread_count,
        c.seller_unread_count,
        c.created_at,
        -- Other user (если я buyer - показываем seller, и наоборот)
        CASE WHEN c.buyer_id = v_user_id THEN c.seller_id ELSE c.buyer_id END AS other_user_id,
        CASE WHEN c.buyer_id = v_user_id THEN seller_profile.username ELSE buyer_profile.username END AS other_user_username,
        CASE WHEN c.buyer_id = v_user_id THEN seller_profile.avatar_url ELSE buyer_profile.avatar_url END AS other_user_avatar,
        CASE WHEN c.buyer_id = v_user_id THEN seller_profile.last_active_at ELSE buyer_profile.last_active_at END AS other_user_last_active,
        -- Product
        p.title AS product_title,
        (
            SELECT pi.image_url 
            FROM product_images pi 
            WHERE pi.product_id = p.id AND pi.is_main = TRUE 
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS product_image,
        p.price AS product_price,
        cond.name AS product_condition
    FROM conversations c
    LEFT JOIN user_profiles buyer_profile ON buyer_profile.user_id = c.buyer_id
    LEFT JOIN user_profiles seller_profile ON seller_profile.user_id = c.seller_id
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = c.product_id
    LEFT JOIN conditions cond ON cond.id = p.condition_id
    WHERE c.id = p_conversation_id
    AND (c.buyer_id = v_user_id OR c.seller_id = v_user_id)
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.send_counter_offer(p_conversation_id uuid, p_offered_price numeric)
 RETURNS TABLE(message_id uuid, counter_offer_id uuid, original_price numeric, offered_price numeric, status counter_offer_status, expires_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
    v_conversation RECORD;
    v_product RECORD;
    v_to_user_id UUID;
    v_counter_offer_id UUID;
    v_message_id UUID;
BEGIN
    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
    END IF;
    
    -- Получаем данные чата
    SELECT c.*, p.price AS product_price, p.id AS prod_id
    INTO v_conversation
    FROM conversations c
    JOIN products p ON p.id = c.product_id
    WHERE c.id = p_conversation_id
    AND (c.buyer_id = v_user_id OR c.seller_id = v_user_id)
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL;
    
    IF v_conversation IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Conversation not found or access denied';
    END IF;
    
    IF v_conversation.product_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot make offer: no product in conversation';
    END IF;
    
    -- Определяем получателя
    v_to_user_id := CASE 
        WHEN v_conversation.buyer_id = v_user_id THEN v_conversation.seller_id
        ELSE v_conversation.buyer_id
    END;
    
    -- Создаём counter offer
    INSERT INTO counter_offers (
        conversation_id,
        product_id,
        from_user_id,
        to_user_id,
        original_price,
        offered_price,
        status,
        expires_at
    ) VALUES (
        p_conversation_id,
        v_conversation.prod_id,
        v_user_id,
        v_to_user_id,
        v_conversation.product_price,
        p_offered_price,
        'pending',
        NOW() + INTERVAL '24 hours'
    )
    RETURNING counter_offers.id INTO v_counter_offer_id;
    
    -- Создаём системное сообщение
    INSERT INTO messages (
        conversation_id, 
        sender_id, 
        content, 
        message_type,
        counter_offer_id
    ) VALUES (
        p_conversation_id,
        v_user_id,
        'Made an offer: $' || p_offered_price::TEXT,
        'counter_offer',
        v_counter_offer_id
    )
    RETURNING messages.id INTO v_message_id;
    
    -- Возвращаем результат
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        v_message_id,
        co.id,
        co.original_price,
        co.offered_price,
        co.status,
        co.expires_at
    FROM counter_offers co
    WHERE co.id = v_counter_offer_id;
END;
$function$
